{{Quote|Bring them, the leader will know.|A Balnab referring to C-3PO and R2-D2|<ref name="Nomad Droids">{{TCW|Nomad Droids}}</ref>}}
The '''Balnab''' were the inhabitants of the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Balnab/Legends|Balnab]].

==History==
The Balnab were made up of [[Unidentified tentacle-faced species/Legends|members of a tentacled faced species]]<ref name=":0">{{TCW|Nomad Droids}}</ref> who survived after their [[Starship/Legends|starship]],<ref name=":1" /> a [[Gozanti-class cruiser/Legends|Gozanti-class cruiser]],<ref name=":2" /> crashed in the canyons on the planet [[Balnab/Legends|Balnab]],<ref name=":0" /> in the relatively recent past<ref name=":1">{{SWE|locations|balnab|Balnab}}</ref> compared to the times of the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]].<ref name=":0" /> The surviving crew became the lone intelligence on the primeval world, thougth intelligence was a relative term.<ref name=":1" /> The Balnab denizens were hoodwinked into cowing before the towering holographic form of [[Albee Dewaw/Legends|Albee Dewaw]],<ref name=":0" /> the iron-fisted dictator of Balnab.<ref name=":1" />

By the time of the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], they had inhabited a region on the planet, used [[Tee-muss/Legends|Tee-muss]] as mounts and hunted local [[Hesten/Legends|Hestens]].<ref name=":0" /> In [[20 BBY/Legends|20 BBY]],<ref>{{TCWdates|406}}</ref> during one [[Hunting/Legends|hunting]] trip, they came across the droids [[C-3PO/Legends|C-3PO]] and [[R2-D2/Legends|R2-D2]]. They brought the droids to their residence, however their leader became furious and killed one of the Balnab. After R2-D2 found that [[DUM-series pit droid|Pit Droids]] were controlling a holographic Dewaw,<ref name=":0" /> the enraged<ref name=":2">{{SW|url=explore/the-clone-wars/ep406|text="Nomad Droids" - ''The Clone Wars'' Episode Guide|nolive=1}}</ref> Balnab attacked and destroyed the droids' control room, creating a large explosion that possibly engulfed the inhabitants.<ref name=":0" />
